value.rationale: The right circular cone is a canonical family used explicitly in the motivating Hadwiger/Steiner-root literature. A natural complete classification is mathematically useful here because the family traverses all three non-ball regions of the Blaschke root diagram. The theorem identifies the previously unstated lower boundary, proves both crossings are unique by a structural square identity, and gives the exact real-root window rather than a routine recomputation at selected parameters.
